name: Psi Warrior
summary: A warrior who channels psionic power into strikes and shields.

features.name: Psionic Power
features.short: Psionic dice for force strikes, shields and telekinesis.
features.summary: You have Psionic Energy dice equal to twice your proficiency bonus (d6, growing with level). Protective Field: reaction, reduce damage by a roll + INT. Psionic Strike: once per turn, add a die + INT force damage. Telekinetic Movement: move an object or creature. You regain one die as a bonus action once per short rest; all return on a long rest.

features.name: Telekinetic Adept
features.summary: Psi-Powered Leap: bonus action, gain a flying speed equal to twice your walking speed this turn (once per short rest, or spend a die). Telekinetic Thrust: when you use Psionic Strike, the target makes a STR save or is knocked prone or pushed 10 ft.

features.name: Guarded Mind
features.short: Resist psychic; spend a die to end charm or fear.
features.summary: You have resistance to psychic damage. At the start of your turn, you can spend a Psionic Energy die to end every charmed or frightened effect on you.

features.name: Bulwark of Force
features.short: Bonus action: give half cover to several allies.
features.summary: As a bonus action, choose up to INT-modifier creatures within 30 ft.; they gain half cover for 1 minute. Once per long rest (or spend a die).

features.name: Telekinetic Master
features.short: Cast Telekinesis and attack while concentrating.
features.summary: You can cast Telekinesis without components using INT; while concentrating on it you can make one weapon attack as a bonus action each turn. Once per long rest (or spend a die).
